assumptions.text: Single-node baseline ceiling assumed; description omits rates and volumes.

entries.driver: Thousands of 1Hz device transmissions in bursts; small packets per PA-01
Every validated or failed sample; 60-second reorder window per PA-01
Long-lived streaming analytics subscribers; fan-out of every window per PA-01
One append per ingested sample; write-heavy per PA-01
Append per backfilled sample; fraction of ingest volume per PA-01

budgets.target: Ingress packet body size and samples per packet
budgets.limit: At most 256 KiB and 500 samples per packet

measurement.assertion: Oversized packet is rejected with 413; boundary-size packet accepted

budgets.limit: At most 2000 in flight; excess rejected, never blocked

measurement.assertion: Packet beyond in-flight limit receives 429 and increments backpressure counter
Concurrency limit key bound and equals 256

budgets.limit: Capacity 4096 events; overflow counted, validation-failed payload retained

measurement.assertion: Depth never exceeds 4096 when consumer is stalled

budgets.limit: At most 10000 buffered samples per device

measurement.assertion: Sample 10001 for one device triggers overflow, buffer size stays 10000

budgets.limit: Window span fixed at 60 seconds by one bounded key

measurement.assertion: Window span key bound and equals 60 seconds

budgets.limit: Buffer of 1024 windows; overflow drops with counter

measurement.assertion: Stalled subscriber buffer stays at 1024; drop counter increments

budgets.limit: At most 500 records per batch, one write statement

measurement.assertion: 500 appended records issue one write statement
Pool maximum key bound and equals 20

budgets.limit: Default 100, maximum 500 rows per keyset page

measurement.assertion: Request for 5000 rows returns at most 500
Failing store receives exactly 3 attempts then append rejected

budgets.limit: Capacity 4096 events; overflow counted as rejected append

measurement.assertion: Depth never exceeds 4096 when store is stalled

budgets.limit: One bounded timeout key per append

measurement.assertion: Append timeout key bound to a positive value

invariants.rule: No unbounded queue between ingestion and downstream contexts
Saturation of reorder window or subscribers is answered, never silent
Burst load never blocks ingress threads; excess rejected with status
Append retries stay bounded; exhausted append is rejected and counted

duties.obligation: Reject packets over size and sample-count limits
Cap in-flight packets; reject excess with counter
Cap concurrent validations with one bounded permit set
Hand-off queue bounded; overflow counted, payload retained
Window buffer bounded per device; overflow counted
Window span comes from one bounded key
Cap stream subscribers; reject excess with status
Slow subscriber buffer bounded; drops counted
Batch appends into one write statement
Store connection pool bounded by one key
History reads keyset-paged with maximum page size
Append retries capped; exhaustion rejected and counted
Consumer intake queue bounded; overflow rejected and counted
Each append carries one bounded timeout key

risks.risk: Reorder window state is lost on restart
risks.mitigation: accepted: window rebuilt from append-only log
risks.residual: Reordering of in-window samples delayed until rebuild completes

risks.risk: Single-node ceiling may be below real burst volume
risks.residual: Excess packets rejected; devices must retransmit

risks.risk: Stalled store drops appends once intake queue is full
risks.residual: Rejected appends counted but not replayed automatically
